name: China Sports Industry Group Co., Ltd. (中体产业集团, SSE 600158)
via: Shanghai-listed sports company; its largest shareholder is the Sports Fund Management Centre of the General Administration of Sport of China (19.49% at 2026-06-30), and the company names the General Administration of Sport as its ultimate controller
note: The General Administration of Sport of China (国家体育总局), a government body, is the actual controller, per the company's 2025 annual report and 2026 half-year report.
